title: 第19章 伤感的回忆第20章 万泉
lines: 为了替江菲亚报仇，那天夜里，他化身死神，杀光了黑帮势力的所有成员，整个小镇到处都是死人和鲜血。当他将匕首插进黑帮首脑的脖子后，身体终于坚持不住，昏倒在了地上。迷迷糊糊中，他看到一个人慢慢朝他走近，然后抱着他离开了那片布满尸体的修罗场。
那个人，就是他后来的导师，圣殿的上任国王，杰克曼。
也算他运气好，当时杰克曼正好路过小镇，看到他血洗黑帮后，动了惜才之心，这才将他带回圣殿培养。如果没有杰克曼，他恐怕早已死在哪个不知名的角落里。
后来，他继任圣殿国王，第一件事情就是肃清四大洲的毒品交易。短短几年间，四大洲的毒品销售额降低百分之八十。虽然很多人心生不满，但在他的强硬手段下，没人敢反对。或许，正是因为这件事情，才导致了今天发生的一切。
他对毒品的态度，损害了太多人的利益，尤其是各国的毒枭，安德鲁之所以能成功篡位，背后也有他们的影子。
看来老头子都算计好了，所以才会提出这样的要求。想到这，他摇头一笑，既然以后要栖身在华国，不妨帮对方这个忙，反正他也不喜欢欠人情。
“江先生，这份资料你认真看看，上面记载的都是三大势力的幕后首脑以及核心成员，如果你有什么不明白的地方，可以给我打电话，这是我的号码。”柳初晴拿出一张名片放在茶几上，然后转身走出了房间。
随手翻开一页纸，一张光头男的照片立刻出现在江来的眼中。资料显示，光头男叫于承光，四十三岁，是三钱帮的首脑人物，他的犯罪记录有二十多项，多为故意伤人和勒索，曾在监狱里关了五年。
另外两个人是罗耀和岳坤，分别掌控着白联社和东红巷，年纪都差不多，四十岁左右，犯罪累累，都在监狱呆过。看完资料，江来对这三位首脑有了初步的了解。他注意到，这三个人有个共同点，都是从监狱释放后开始发迹，短短几年的时间便建立了三大势力，日益壮大。
“咦！岳坤？”他喃喃自语，“这人的名字听起来好熟悉，似乎在哪里听过。”思索了片刻，他心头一动，终于记了起来。
叶芙渠跟他说过，齐斌层要求她去陪一位商业伙伴，因为内心抗拒，她迟迟不肯就范。如果他没记错的话，叶芙渠好像提到过齐斌的商业伙伴，名字就叫岳坤。
“同名同姓？”江来暗自摇头，这天下恐怕没这么巧合的事情。好在他还留着齐斌的性命，或许可以找他问个清楚。
思忖间，门外传来一阵钥匙人孔的声音，紧接着，只见房门打开，叶芙渠从外面走了进来。估计是为了给新的经纪公司留下好印象，叶芙渠特意穿了一件白色宽肩束腰外衣，下身搭配一条白色喇叭裤和一双水晶高跟鞋，衬托出修长高挑的身姿，还有纤细的柳腰，一头柔顺的秀发披肩而落，带着微微的波浪卷，精致的脸蛋略施薄粉，美艳动人，端庄大方。
看到江来好整以暇的坐在沙发上，翻阅着手中的资料，叶芙渠好奇的凑过来，问道：“这是什么？”
“男女间不可描述的小说，你要看吗？”
叶芙渠俏脸微红，轻啐了一声，连忙收回目光，朝着厨房走去。看着她的背影，江来嘴角微扬，露出一丝淡淡的笑意。虽然被女人伤过，但家里有个美女还是挺养眼的。
“你今天怎么样，跟新东家谈妥了吗？”
“还不错，毕竟我有人气基础，又有几部口碑不错的影视剧作品，他们没多犹豫就签下了我。”说到这，叶芙渠从厨房探出头来，笑盈盈道：“你可能不信，他们正好在找合适的演员饰演一部都市剧的女二号，恰好导演也在那，一眼就相中了我，你说我是不是运气很好？”
江来随口道：“你不是运气好，而是碰到了贵人。”
“哼！你就知道往自己脸上贴金。”
“实话实说而已。”
“如果合同落实的话，半个月后我就要去外地拍戏了，可能需要两个月左右，到时候你一个人在家，没人照顾你怎么办？要不我去请个保姆。”
“不用了，你去忙你的，我能照顾好自己。”
看完手中的资料，江来掏出一支香烟点燃，缓缓吐出一口烟雾。三个地下势力的情况他都了解得差不多了，在他眼里，这些人都是小打小闹，上不了台面，最关键的是找出幕后经营毒品的黑手，这才是重中之重。
能够把毒品运往周边几个省份，进行大面积的销售，这绝非一般人能做得到，对方应该掌握着隐秘且安全的走私渠道，而且还有成熟健全的销售网络。
不知不觉间，一支香烟已经烧了大半，感受到指尖传来的灼热，江来慢慢回过神，眼中迷茫渐渐消散，露出一道迫人的精光。
虽然老头子利用他瓦解QZ市的地下势力，但对他来说，这同样是一个契机，正好可以组建属于自己的势力。当然，这一切必须暗中进行，万一被军方知晓，他别想有好日子过。
一转眼间，三天过去。
大清早，天还灰蒙蒙的，江来已经从起床，独自在小区内晨跑了半小时，再加上一小时的基础锻炼，直到满头大汗，他才慢慢走回住处。
回到家，只见叶芙渠穿着一身宽松的睡袍，露出半截白嫩的小腿，在厨房里准备着丰盛的早餐。听到门响声，她头也不回的说道：“换洗衣服都给你准备好了，先去冲个澡，早餐马上好。”
江来微微一笑，他发现叶芙渠越来越称职了，只要是他的事情，全都安排得妥妥当当，根本不用他费神。可惜，叶芙渠很快要出远门拍戏，他的好日子也要到头了。
“导演约了我今天讨论剧本，可能要晚点回来，你自己叫外卖吧。”
江来还在餐桌旁狼吞虎咽，叶芙渠已经穿戴整齐准备出门了。临走前，她还不忘放上几张百元大钞在桌上，这让江来感觉自己像是个被包养的小白脸。
吃过早饭，江来稍作休息，便独自离开了华庭御府。
昨晚比尔森打电话给他，让他今天抽空去一趟公司。自己好歹领着南月集团的薪水，总不能整天玩失踪，那未免太不厚道了。
content_en:
In order to avenge Jiang Feiya, that night, he transformed into the God of Death and killed all the members of the gang. The whole town was filled with dead people and blood. When he inserted the dagger into the gang leader's neck, his body finally couldn't hold on anymore and he fainted on the ground. In a daze, he saw a person slowly approaching him, then holding him and leaving the Shura field filled with corpses.
That person was his later mentor, the previous king of the temple, Jackman.
He was lucky. Jackman happened to be passing through the town at that time. After seeing him wiping out gangsters, he was moved by his talent and took him back to the temple for training. If it weren't for Jackman, he might have died somewhere unknown.
Later, when he succeeded as King of the Temple, his first task was to eliminate the drug trade on four continents. In just a few years, drug sales fell by 80 percent on four continents. Although many people were dissatisfied, no one dared to object due to his tough tactics. Perhaps, it was precisely because of this incident that everything happened today.
His attitude towards drugs has harmed the interests of too many people, especially drug lords from various countries. The reason why Andrew was able to successfully usurp the throne also has their shadow behind him.
It seems that the old man has planned everything, so he made such a request. Thinking of this, he shook his head and smiled. Since he was going to live in China in the future, he might as well do this favor. He didn't like to owe favors anyway.
"Mr. Jiang, please read this information carefully. It contains the behind-the-scenes leaders and core members of the three major forces. If you don't understand anything, you can call me. This is my number." Liu Chuqing took out a business card and put it on the coffee table, then turned and walked out of the room.
Turning over a page at random, a photo of a bald man immediately appeared in Jiang Lai's eyes. Information shows that the bald man is Yu Chengguang, 43 years old, and the leader of the Sanqian Gang. He has more than 20 criminal records, mostly for intentional injury and extortion. He has been in prison for five years.
The other two people are Luo Yao and Yue Kun, who control Bailianshe and Donghongxiang respectively. They are both about the same age, about forty years old. They have committed many crimes and have both been in prison. After reading the information, Jiang Lai had a preliminary understanding of these three leaders. He noticed that these three people had one thing in common. They all started to become successful after being released from prison. In just a few years, they established three major forces and grew stronger day by day.
"Eh! Yue Kun?" He murmured to himself, "This person's name sounds so familiar, as if he has heard it somewhere." After thinking for a moment, his mind moved, and he finally remembered it.
Ye Fuqu told him that Qi Bin asked her to accompany a business partner, but she refused to comply because of her inner resistance. If he remembered correctly, Ye Fuqu seemed to have mentioned Qi Bin's business partner, whose name was Yue Kun.
"Same name?" Jiang Lai shook his head secretly. I'm afraid there is no such coincidence in this world. Fortunately, he still kept Qi Bin alive, so maybe he could ask him for details.
While thinking about it, there was a sound of a keyhole being clicked outside the door, and then the door opened and Ye Fuqu walked in from the outside. Probably in order to leave a good impression on the new agency, Ye Fuqu specially wore a white broad-shouldered tunic, paired with a pair of white bell-bottom pants and a pair of crystal high heels, which highlighted her slender and tall figure, as well as her slender waist. Her silky hair fell down her shoulders with slight waves. Her delicate face was lightly powdered, making her charming, dignified and generous.
Seeing Jiang Lai sitting on the sofa leisurely and flipping through the information in his hands, Ye Fuqu came over curiously and asked, "What is this?"
"The indescribable novel between men and women, do you want to read it?"
Ye Fuqu's pretty face turned red, she spat softly, quickly looked away, and walked towards the kitchen. Looking at her back, Jiang Lai raised the corners of his mouth, revealing a faint smile. Although he has been hurt by women, having a beautiful woman at home is quite eye-catching.
"How are you today? Have you reached an agreement with the new owner?"
"It's not bad. After all, I have a good foundation of popularity and have several well-regarded film and television dramas. They signed me without much hesitation." Speaking of this, Ye Fuqu poked his head out of the kitchen and said with a smile: "You may not believe it, but they are looking for a suitable actor to play the second female lead in an urban drama. The director happened to be there, and he took a liking to me at a glance. Do you think I am very lucky?"
Jiang Lai said casually: "You are not lucky, but you met a noble person."
"Hmph! You know how to put gold on your face."
"Just telling the truth."
"If the contract is implemented, I will go out to film in half a month. It may take about two months. What will you do if you are at home alone with no one to take care of you? How about I hire a nanny."
"No, you go and do your business, I can take care of myself."
After reading the information in his hand, Jiang Lai took out a cigarette, lit it, and slowly exhaled a puff of smoke. He has a pretty good understanding of the situation of the three underground forces. In his eyes, these people are just small-time gangsters who cannot be brought to the forefront. The most important thing is to find out the mastermind behind the drug operation. This is the top priority.
Being able to transport drugs to several surrounding provinces and sell them on a large scale is definitely not something ordinary people can do. The other party should have secret and safe smuggling channels, as well as a mature and sound sales network.
Unknowingly, most of the cigarette had been burned. Feeling the burning heat from his fingertips, Jiang Lai slowly came back to his senses. The confusion in his eyes gradually dissipated, revealing a compelling light.
Although the old man used him to dismantle the underground forces in QZ City, for him, this was also an opportunity to form his own force. Of course, all this must be done secretly. If the military finds out, he will never have a good life.
…
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
Early in the morning, the sky was still gray. Jiang Lai had already gotten up and ran alone in the community for half an hour, plus an hour of basic exercise. He slowly walked back to his residence until he was sweating profusely.
When she got home, she saw Ye Fuqu wearing a loose nightgown, exposing half of her white and tender legs, and preparing a sumptuous breakfast in the kitchen. When she heard the sound of the door, she said without looking back: "I've prepared a change of clothes for you. Go take a shower first. Breakfast will be ready soon."
Jiang Lai smiled slightly. He found that Ye Fuqu was becoming more and more competent. As long as it was his affairs, everything was arranged properly without him having to worry about it at all. Unfortunately, Ye Fuqu will soon be away filming, and his good days are coming to an end.
"The director has made an appointment with me to discuss the script today. I may have to come back later. You can order takeout by yourself."
Jiang Lai was still devouring food at the dining table, and Ye Fuqu was already dressed and ready to go out. Before leaving, she didn't forget to put a few hundred-dollar bills on the table, which made Jiang Lai feel like a kept pretty boy.
After breakfast, Jiang Lai took a short rest and left the Huating Palace alone.
Bilson called him last night and asked him to take time to go to the company today. After all, I am receiving a salary from the Nanyue Group, so I can't just disappear all day long. That would be too unkind.
